Google has internalized network effects where it harvests user usage to enhance services via a feedback loop, leading to total commoditization of websites.
Facebook has internalized network effects where users are locked into the network, leading to total commoditization of content regardless of the source.
Microsoft built a three-sided network between developers, users, and OEMs, which is a brilliant business they continue to leverage today.
Uber is in a weird spot because its network effects are externalized and it tries to commoditize drivers, resulting in an oppositional relationship with them and high spending on driver recruitment.
Airbnb had a positive relationship with hosts where they were commoditized to an extent, but the platform was totally internalized.
